Q6052435.label: Integrated Revolutionary Organizations
Q6052435.summary: The Integrated Revolutionary Organizations was a political organization in Cuba formed in July 1961 as an intermediate step toward the creation of a unified Marxist–Leninist party. It merged Fidel Castro's 26th of July Movement, the Revolutionary Directorate of 13 March Movement, and the Popular Socialist Party (PSP), the island's pre-revolution Communist party. The ORI was intended to become the United Party of the Socialist Revolution (PURSC) and eventually the Communist Party of Cuba.

Q104853587.label: 1944 Barbadian general election
Q104853587.summary: General elections were held in Barbados on 27 November 1944. Three parties each won eight of the 24 seats in the House of Assembly.

Q22961747.label: Italian oil drilling referendum, 2016
Q22961747.desc: referendum on repealing a law about oil and natural gas drilling
Q22961747.summary: An abrogative referendum on oil and natural gas drilling was held in Italy on 17 April 2016. The referendum was on the proposed repealing of a law that allows gas and oil drilling concessions extracting hydrocarbon within 12 nautical miles of the Italian coast to be prolonged until the exhaustion of the useful life of the fields.

Q3722323.label: 2000 Bosnian parliamentary election
Q3722323.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 11 November 2000. Voter turnout was 64%.

Q782419.label: People's Party
Q782419.summary: The People's Party or Populist Party was a conservative and pro-monarchist Greek political party founded by Dimitrios Gounaris, the main political rival of Eleftherios Venizelos and his Liberal Party. The party existed from 1920 until 1958.

Q1584723.label: 1936 Finnish parliamentary election
Q1584723.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 1 and 2 July 1936. Following the election Prime Minister Toivo Mikael Kivimäki of the National Progressive Party was defeated in a confidence vote in September 1936 and resigned in October. Kyösti Kallio of the Agrarian League formed a centrist minority government after Pehr Evind Svinhufvud refused to allow the Social Democrats to join the government.

Q505939.label: Battle of Vukovar
Q505939.desc: 1991 siege of Vukovar in eastern Croatia by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) during the Croatian War of Independence
Q505939.img: Map 2 - Croatia - Battle of Vukovar, September-November 1991.jpg
Q505939.summary: The Battle of Vukovar was an 87-day siege of Vukovar in eastern Croatia by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA), supported by various paramilitary forces from Serbia, between August and November 1991. Before the Croatian War of Independence the Baroque town was a prosperous, mixed community of Croats, Serbs and other ethnic groups.

Q3975763.label: massacre of Via D'Amelio
Q3975763.desc: Mafia Bomb attack in Palermo, Italy
Q3975763.summary: The via D'Amelio bombing was a terrorist attack by the Sicilian Mafia, which took place in Palermo, Sicily, Italy, on 19 July 1992. It killed Paolo Borsellino, the anti-Mafia Italian magistrate, and five members of his police escort: Agostino Catalano, Emanuela Loi, Vincenzo Li Muli, Walter Eddie Cosina, and Claudio Traina.

mentions.c: Italy: Terrorist attack: massacre of Via D'Amelio

Q1143379.label: 1991–1992 South Ossetia War
aliases: war between South Ossetia and Georgia
war between Georgia and South Ossetia
Q1143379.summary: The 1991–1992 South Ossetia War was fought between Georgian government forces and ethnic Georgian militias on one side and the forces of South Ossetian separatists and Russia on the other. The war ended with a Dagomys Agreement, signed on 24 June 1992, which established a joint peacekeeping force and left South Ossetia divided between the rival authorities.

Q23635.label: Bermuda
Q23635.desc: British overseas territory in the North Atlantic Ocean
Q23635.summary: Bermuda is a British Overseas Territory in the North Atlantic Ocean. The closest land outside the territory is in the US state of North Carolina, about 1,035 km (643 mi) to the west-northwest.
